titleText: JTF News: CBC News, BBC News
mainText: The United States conducted strikes on Iran following an attack on a cargo ship.
John Bolton, former adviser to President Trump, pleaded guilty to mishandling classified documents.
Earthquakes in Venezuela resulted in 920 deaths.
President Trump threatened a 100% tariff on European imports if countries impose a tax on digital services.
A death toll climbs following an earthquake in Venezuela, and search operations for missing persons are underway.
